_comment: When each income standard is expected to republish. check-refresh.yml compares the newest effective_date in income_limits against the most recent expected refresh that is at least grace_days in the past, and opens an issue for anything overdue. expected_month is 1-12; grace_days absorbs normal publication slippage. Standards with no rows loaded on purpose (placeholders) are listed in skip.

HHS-FPG.note: HHS publishes the poverty guidelines in mid-January, effective January.

HUD-MFI.note: HUD income limits publish each spring, usually April.

HUD-MTSP.note: MTSP (LIHTC) limits follow the HUD income limits by a few weeks.

HUD-MTSP-HERA.note: HERA Special publishes with the MTSP set.

HUD-HOME.note: HOME limits publish in late spring, effective June.

HUD-HTF.note: Housing Trust Fund limits publish with the HOME set.

OR-SMI.note: LIHEAP state median income is set per federal fiscal year, effective October 1.

MN-SMI.note: LIHEAP state median income is set per federal fiscal year, effective October 1.

OHCS-MIRL.note: OHCS issues its rent and income limits workbook after HUD's spring release.

OHCS-THGF.note: Published in the same OHCS workbook as MIRL.

HAJC-HCV.note: HAJC republishes its voucher limits after HUD's release; PHAs can lag.

JHCDC-HCV.note: JHCDC republishes after HUD's release; confirm by phone if flagged.

USDA-502-GUARANTEED.note: USDA revises the HB-1-3555 Appendix 5 guaranteed limits annually, usually early summer.
